data.body: `select_review_findings` documents three distinct behaviors (`None` → default limit, `0` → disabled/empty, negative → `ValueError`) but no tests exercise any of them, so the zero-handling regression noted above (and any future regression in the negative-value or default-limit paths) can ship undetected. Add unit tests asserting `select_review_findings(items, None)` applies the default limit, `select_review_findings(items, 0) == []`, a positive limit smaller than the list truncates correctly, and a negative value raises `ValueError`.
